Send a raw SQL query to the database

Source: R/ojo_query.R
ojo_query.Rd

Executes a raw SQL query against a database connection. This function is backend-agnostic and will send the query to any valid DBI connection.

Usage

ojo_query(query, con = NULL)

Arguments

query

The SQL query to send to the database. The user is responsible for ensuring the syntax is correct for the target database backend.

con

The database connection to use. If NULL, a default connection to the primary Postgres database will be created and used.

Value

A lazy tibble with the ojo_tbl class.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Run a query against the default Postgres database
ojo_query("SELECT * FROM case LIMIT 10")

# Run a query against a manual DuckDB connection
duck_con <- ojo_connect(db_config = db_config(.driver = "duckdb"))
ojo_query("SELECT * FROM 'my_duck_db_file.parquet' LIMIT 5", con = duck_con)
} # }
